title: A service's log event catalogue (0.13.0)
description: logging/events.<service>.v1.json in each service's repository (logging/events.common.v1.json here, service "*", for the events every service shares). Lists every event name the service writes, the levels it may have, whether it is about a call (call_scoped: xsid and tenant_id required) and the fields it must carry. contract-check --logs checks log lines against log-record.v1 plus the catalogues given. Adding an event or a level is a change to the service's own file; renaming or removing one breaks dashboards and alerts that use it (CONVENTIONS "Logging (log-record.v1)").

service.description: The service's name as its records write it, or "*" for the common catalogue.

description.description: What happened, for the person or model reading the log: when it is written and what it means for the flow.

call_scoped.description: About one call: xsid and tenant_id are required.

requires.description: Correlation fields of log-record.v1 the record must carry (beyond xsid and tenant_id for a call-scoped event).

attrs.description: Keys the record's attrs must hold.

transition.description: A state machine transition: from_state and to_state are required.

decision.description: The event may carry a decision object (debug or trace, or sampled).

sample_rate.description: With decision: the fraction of info-level records that carry a sampled decision.

dedup.description: Repeats of this event are rate limited: at most one record per key per window, the rest counted in repeat_count.

key.description: Fields that make two records the same (besides event, error.code and error.kind).
